summary: Master gender-transformative family planning. Learn GESI frameworks, WHO MEC, and SBCC strategies to improve health outcomes. Professional 5-day course.
lede: Family planning programming connects reproductive health services with gender equality, informed choice and equitable access. This intermediate course is for professionals managing or advising health and social development initiatives who need to design and improve family planning programs. It builds skills in gender analysis, inclusive service design, behavior-change communication and using gender-disaggregated data to guide decisions.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is designed for professionals currently managing or advising on health and social development initiatives who require advanced integration skills.
modules: Gender Analysis Frameworks in Health Programming
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2 years of experience in public health, social development, or program management. Familiarity with basic reproductive health concepts and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) is required. No prior coding or advanced statistical knowledge is necessary, though basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel is recommended for data exercises.
